# Dim Light

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Vision and Senses](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#DimLight)*

An area with Dim Light is Lightly Obscured. *See also* "[Lightly Obscured](Lightly-Obscured.md)" and "Playing the Game" ("[Exploration](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#ObscuredAreas)").
